description: Source code for configuration data handling in a build system, including file existence checks, file comparison, directory creation, dependency tracking, and configuration symbol management.

methods.name: conf_get_configname
methods.description: Returns the name of the current configuration file, defaulting to '.config' if not set.

methods.name: conf_get_autoconfig_name
methods.description: Returns the filename for auto configuration, defaulting to 'include/config/auto.conf'.

methods.name: conf_get_autoheader_name
methods.description: Returns the filename for auto header, defaulting to 'include/generated/autoconf.h'.

methods.name: conf_get_rustccfg_name
methods.description: Returns the filename for Rust configuration, defaulting to 'include/generated/rustc_cfg'.

methods.name: conf_set_message_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for configuration messages.

methods.name: conf_set_changed
methods.description: Sets the changed state of the configuration.

methods.name: conf_get_changed
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration has been changed.

methods.name: conf_write_defconfig
methods.description: Writes a minimal configuration file with default values.

methods.name: conf_write
methods.description: Writes the current configuration to a specified file.

methods.name: conf_write_autoconf
methods.description: Generates dependency files and configuration files for autoconf, including auto header and Rust config.

methods.name: conf_write_autoconf_cmd
methods.description: Creates a dependency command file for autoconf.

methods.name: conf_touch_deps
methods.description: Creates dependency files for configuration symbols.

methods.name: __conf_write_autoconf
methods.description: Helper function to write autoconf files with specific comment styles.

methods.name: set_all_choice_values
methods.description: Sets all non-assigned choice values to 'no' for a given choice symbol.
